text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top: each product against ERA5 (exploratory); each label gives the product's own error. Bottom: the six planned contrasts. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to August 2026. UKV rebuilt from its snapshots, the page's live-service recommendation, scores 8.18% (post hoc; not drawn). Planned: one of the comparisons written into the study plan before any result existed. Every other row is exploratory.'
